room.2: We've got a lot to do.

helloRank1.3: You're supposed to make the money go up, not down.

helloRank2.3: Mr. Gambler, do you know how to dodge bullets?

bet.blackjack: This is your bet for one hand. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Hit takes a card, stand keeps what you have.
bet.coinflip: This is your bet. Pick heads or tails under it and join the next flip. A win pays 1.94x.
bet.crash: This is your bet. The multiplier climbs until it crashes; cash out before that and you win your bet times it. Wait too long and it's gone.
bet.dice: This is your bet: what you risk on one roll. Dice picks a number from 0 to 100; you win if it lands on the green side. Start small, you're new.
bet.hilo: This is your bet. Guess if the next card is higher or lower; every right guess raises your payout. Cash out whenever you like.
bet.mines: This is your bet. Bombs hide under some of the tiles; every safe tile you reveal raises your payout. Cash out before you hit one.
bet.plinko: This is your bet for one ball. It bounces down the pins and lands on a multiplier. The edges pay the most and hit the least.
bet.slots: This is your bet: what one spin costs. The minus and plus buttons halve it or double it. Line up matching symbols to win.

tour.caseLine: Which of those do you like the most? Pick a case to open. I like the Dogs Case.
tour.caseWait: Waiting for you to pick one
tour.doneEven: Broke even? Boring, but safe. Every bet still gave you XP, and the higher your level, the more balance you get from my pot.
tour.doneLose: Lost? Everyone does, sometimes. Every bet still gave you XP, and the higher your level, the more balance you get from my pot.
tour.doneOut: Now go. You can play freely, or follow the missions.
tour.doneWin: You won? Beginner's luck, obviously. Every bet also gave you XP, and the higher your level, the more balance you get from my pot.

drop.2: A {{rarity}} {{item}}. Not bad for a first try. It's in your inventory now, you can keep it or sell it.
drop.3: An {{rarity}} {{item}}, first try? Lucky. It's in your inventory now, you can keep it or sell it.

drop.5: {{item}}. {{rarity}}. On your FIRST case. Do you know how long I've... never mind. It's in your inventory now, you can keep it or sell it. Don't you dare sell it.

tour.endAnyTime: You can end the tour at any step.
tour.gamesLine: Opening cases can get expensive fast, and my pot won't be enough. Games are nice to get more K₽, so pick one to play now.
tour.gamesNote: Every bet gives you XP, whichever you pick.

tour.openMeLine: That's me, down in the corner. Click me and I'll open up.
tour.openMeWait: Waiting for you to open me
tour.openTooDear: Nice taste, wrong wallet. That one costs more than you have. Pick a cheaper one.
tour.playLine: That's the button. Press it when you're ready. Win or lose, I want to see it.

pokes.1: You need to click ON the jar.
pokes.2: I am not the jar. The jar is in the yellow square.
pokes.3: Are you not seeing the square? Here, try now.
pokes.5: And I was trying to be nice... looks like you don't deserve kindness.
pokes.6: Do you think this is funny?
pokes.7: I could just go away and never give you balance to play.
pokes.8: Which would be bad for you.
pokes.11: Click the jar, you stupid bastard.
pokes.17: I know that I'm very clickable, but...
pokes.18: But please, just click the jar.
pokes.19: I promise I will not disappear if you click the jar.
pokes.20: The jar will not break, click it.
pokes.21: Why are you making this so difficult?
pokes.24: You don't want to play the game?
pokes.25: C'mon, the minigames are more fun than this.
pokes.26: I'll show you around. Once you click the jar.
pokes.28: It's a goddamn jar that gives you money, why won't you click it??

pokes.31: I finally got it. Now I want to share this happiness with everyone.
pokes.32: Will you fulfill my wish? Click the jar.
pokes.34: Click me if you like kissing men.

tour.potLine: You'll need K₽ to play here, so I'll give you some. Go ahead, take it. Click on the jar.
tour.potTaken: Good. Don't worry, the jar fills automatically. In around 8 minutes it will be full again, so come back here if you need more balance. Now let's spend some K₽.
tour.rangeLine: And this bar decides it. Drag the handle to change your winning range: more green wins more often, but each win pays less. The Roll Over button flips which side wins.
tour.rollLine: There it goes. Eyes on the reel.
tour.welcomeBackBody: My name is Daisu. I'll be handling your bonus, so let's get along. I know you already know how to play, but... do you want me to show you around?
tour.welcomeBody: Nice to meet you, {{name}}. You look lost, so I'll make you an offer: a quick tour to learn how to play. A minute, maybe two, if you keep up.

roadmap.chapterDoneLine: Fine. You're not hopeless after all. Here's what I want from you next.
roadmap.finishedLine: You did everything I asked. I'll think of more. Don't get comfortable.

r1-bonus.desc: Play the game my bonus is on. Right now that's {{game}}.
r1-bonus.help: Every time you take from my jar I add a little extra that only works on one game. Right now it's on {{game}}. Bet there once and the bonus pays before your wallet does.
r1-bonus.title: Spend a Daisu bonus

r1-full-pot.desc: Wait until my jar is full, then take it. A full pot pays 25% more.
r1-full-pot.help: Patience. My jar fills over 8 minutes and the bar shows how far along it is. Take it only when it says Full and you get the whole pot, with the full-pot bonus on top.
r1-full-pot.title: Take a full pot

r1-level.desc: Every bet earns XP, win or lose.
r1-level.help: Levels come from betting, whatever the result. And the higher your level, the bigger my pot gets, so it pays twice.
r1-level.title: Reach level {{target}}

r1-pin.desc: Pin a character you own to your profile. Everyone who visits sees it.
r1-pin.help: Open your inventory and press the heart on the character you like most. You can only pin one, and only that one counts on the Top Fan boards.
r1-pin.title: Pin a character

r2-games.desc: Bet on {{target}} different games. One bet each is enough.
r2-games.help: Crash, slots, dice, blackjack, whatever you like. One bet on each of {{target}} different games does it, and you might find a favorite.
r2-games.title: Play {{target}} different games

r2-gift.desc: Spin my daily gift once. It's free, every day.
r2-gift.help: Once a day I have a gift for you: spin it and take the prize. Open it from my card when it lights up.
r2-gift.title: Spin the daily gift

r2-level.desc: Keep betting. Every bet earns XP.
r2-level.help: Same as before, just more of it. Level {{target}} makes my pot bigger too, so don't slack.
r2-level.title: Reach level {{target}}

r2-sell.desc: Sell something you won back for K₽.
r2-sell.help: Anything you get from a case can go back for K₽. Open your inventory, pick an item and sell it. Keep the ones you like.
r2-sell.title: Sell an item

r3-cases.help: Cheap ones count the same as expensive ones, and opening several at once counts each one.
r3-cases.title: Open {{target}} cases

r3-collection.desc: Open one of your case collections.
r3-collection.help: Every case has a collection: all the items it can drop. Get the Collection Book in my shop, then open one from the Collections tab on your profile and see what you're missing.
r3-collection.title: Look through a collection

r3-market.desc: Buy or sell an item on the marketplace.
r3-market.help: The market is where players trade with each other. Get the Trader's License in my shop, then buy something you want, or list one of your items and wait for a buyer.
r3-market.title: Trade on the market

r3-streak.desc: Spin the daily gift {{target}} days in a row.
r3-streak.help: Come back every day and spin. Miss a day and the streak starts over, and the longer it runs, the better the prizes get.
r3-streak.title: A {{target}}-day gift streak

r4-collection.desc: Own every item in one case's collection.
r4-collection.help: Pick a case and get everything it can drop, from openings or from the market. It counts the moment you have it all.
r4-collection.title: Complete a collection

r4-level.desc: Keep betting. Every bet earns XP.
r4-level.help: You know how this works by now. Level {{target}}. Go.
r4-level.title: Reach level {{target}}

r4-stake.desc: Bet K₽ {{target}} in total, on anything.
r4-stake.help: Every bet counts: games, cases, battles and predictions. It adds up faster than you think.
r4-stake.title: Bet K₽ {{target}}

r4-streak.desc: Spin the daily gift {{target}} days in a row.
r4-streak.help: A whole week, every single day. I'll know if you skip one.
r4-streak.title: A {{target}}-day gift streak

r5-battle.desc: Win a case battle against other players.
r5-battle.help: In a battle everyone opens the same cases and the best total takes it all. Start one or join one on the Case Battles page.
r5-battle.title: Win a case battle

r5-level.desc: Keep betting. Every bet earns XP.
r5-level.help: Level {{target}}. Most people never get here. Prove you're not most people.
r5-level.title: Reach level {{target}}

r5-stake.desc: Bet K₽ {{target}} in total, on anything.
r5-stake.help: Half a million. You're not new anymore, so don't act like it.
r5-stake.title: Bet K₽ {{target}}

r5-top-fan.desc: Be the top fan of the character you pinned.
r5-top-fan.help: The Top Fan boards rank players by how many copies of their pinned character they own. Pin one, own the most, and the crown is yours.
r5-top-fan.title: Become a Top Fan

battle.line: Pick cases below, then this button starts the battle. Everyone opens the same cases and the best total takes it all.

bonus.play: Now play a round. Any bet counts, and the bonus pays first.
bonus.strip: That's my bonus, right above your bet, with its clock. A bet here spends it before your wallet.
bonus.take: No bonus right now. Take from my jar and a little extra lands on {{game}}.

cases.line: Any case counts, cheap or expensive. Pick one and open it.

chat.line: Type here and everyone sees it. Be nice, or at least be funny.

collection.complete: The bar shows how much of each collection you own. Fill one all the way and its badge is yours.
collection.line: Every case has a collection. Open one to see what you have and what you're still missing.
collection.wait: Waiting for you to open one

fans.line: This tab shows every character you own and how far you are from being its Top Fan. Pin the one you're closest on.

games.line: Pick a game, any game. I'll show you where the bet goes and which button plays it.

gift.later: You already spun today. The timer says when the next one is ready. Miss it and the streak starts over.
gift.pick: Pick a collection. The gift is a case from it, and the longer your streak, the better it gets.
gift.spin: Now spin. Then come back tomorrow and spin again, or the streak starts over.

market.line: Everything players are selling is in here. Open an item to buy it or make an offer, and you can list your own from this page too.

pin.done: Pinned. Everyone who opens your profile sees it now. Not bad taste, I suppose.
pin.empty: Nothing to pin yet. Open a case first, then come back and pick a favorite.
pin.line: See the hearts? Click the one on the character you like most. Everyone who visits your profile sees who you picked, so choose well.
pin.linePhone: See the hearts? Tap the one on the character you like most. Everyone who visits your profile sees who you picked, so choose well.

pot.line: My jar. The bar fills over 8 minutes, and a full jar pays the full-pot bonus on top. Take it early and you only get what's in it.

predictions.line: Every card is a market. Open one, pick an outcome and buy shares; they pay out if it happens, and you can sell before then.

sell.done: Sold. That's K₽ back in your wallet. See? Easy.
sell.empty: Nothing to sell yet. Open a case first.
sell.line: Hover an item and press its sell button. It turns back into K₽ right away, so pick one you won't miss.
sell.linePhone: Tap an item and sell a copy. It turns back into K₽ right away, so pick one you won't miss.

shop.failed: Could not buy that. Try again.

chatPass.about: Lets you send messages in the site chat. Reading it never needs a pass.
chatPass.name: Chat Pass
chatPass.opened: You can talk now. Try to say something interesting. Want me to show you where?
chatPass.pitch: Paying to talk. Some people would pay you to stay quiet.
chatPass.what: Talk in the site chat. Reading is always free.

collectionBook.about: Opens the Collections tab: every case you collect from, what you're still missing, and a quick way to sell duplicates. Finishing a whole collection earns its badge.
collectionBook.lockedBody: The Collection Book tracks every case you collect from, shows what you're still missing and sells your duplicates in one go.
collectionBook.name: Collection Book
collectionBook.opened: It's yours. The Collections tab is open now. Want me to walk you through it? There are a lot of pages.
collectionBook.pitch: A whole book for your collection. Try not to cry when you see how empty it is.
collectionBook.what: Opens the Collections tab: every case you collect from, what's missing, and a quick way to sell duplicates.

predictionPass.about: Opens predictions: buy shares on what happens next, and sell them whenever the price moves your way.
predictionPass.lockedBody: The Prediction Pass lets you buy shares on what happens next and sell them when the price moves.
predictionPass.name: Prediction Pass
predictionPass.opened: Predictions are open. Want me to show you how a market works?
predictionPass.pitch: Betting on the future. Very grown up of you.
predictionPass.what: Buy shares on what happens next, and sell them when the price moves.

tradersLicense.about: Lets you buy from other players, place buy orders and list your own items on the marketplace.
tradersLicense.lockedBody: You can look around all you want. The license is {{price}} at level {{level}}, in Daisu's shop.
tradersLicense.lockedTitle: Buying and selling needs a Trader's License
tradersLicense.name: Trader's License
tradersLicense.opened: Licensed. Buy, list, place orders, the marketplace is all yours. Want me to show you around it?
tradersLicense.pitch: Official paperwork, so you can haggle with strangers. Don't get scammed. Actually, do. It's funny.

help.canIUpgradeItems: Can I upgrade items in my inventory?
help.crashArtsAndBanner: Crash arts and banner art are from Urban Legend in Limbo.
help.enjoyPlayingTheGames: Enjoy playing the games and good luck!
help.exploreTheVirtualMarketplace: Explore the virtual marketplace at KaniCasino, where you can buy and sell in-game items with other players. Read on to understand how the market works.
help.haveQuestionsOrNeed: Have questions or need assistance? Feel free to reach out to us through the following channels:
help.ifYouNeedAssistance: If you need assistance or have any questions, you can contact us via email at novadrake76@gmail.com or on Discord: novadrake76
help.inTheSlotGame: In the Slot Game, players spin a slot machine with various symbols. Different symbol combinations result in wins with varying payouts. The cat symbol is the highest paying symbol, and it can substitute for any other symbol.
help.marketBuyingBody: Browse the market to discover a variety of items available for purchase. Choose items based on your preferences, strategy, and in-game goals.
help.marketEconomyBody: The market's economy is driven by the rarity of items and player demand. Keep an eye on trends and adjust your buying and selling strategies accordingly.
help.marketInteractionsBody: Engage with other players through the market. Negotiate prices, make deals, and build a thriving in-game economy together.
help.marketListingBody: Players can list their in-game items for sale on the market, setting prices based on the rarity and demand for each item.
help.marketSellingBody: Sell your unwanted or duplicate items on the market to earn in-game currency (K₽). Set competitive prices to attract potential buyers.
help.marketTransparencyBody: The market operates with transparency. Sellers and buyers can view relevant information about each transaction, fostering a fair and trustworthy environment.
help.playBalanceBody: Upon logging in, you will receive an initial balance of K₽1000.
help.playBonusBody: Every 8 minutes, you receive a bonus. The bonus amount is calculated as K₽200 multiplied by 10% of your current level.
help.playCasesBody: Explore the case system. Opening cases can reward you with various in-game items. The rarity of items may affects their value.
help.playGamesBody: Engage in live games like Crash and Coin Flip to increase your balance. Successful gameplay contributes to your overall level - you win 5XP for every K₽1 spent.
help.playLoginBody: Sign in to your account to start playing. If you don't have an account, you may need to register.
help.playMarketBody: Visit the Marketplace to buy and sell items. Create an economy based on the rarity of items and market demand.
help.slotArtCredit: Slots arts are from Touhou Kouryuudou ~ Unconnected Marketeers.
help.theCrashGameFeatures: The Crash Game features a multiplier that grows over time. Players can place bets and choose to cash out at any point before the game crashes. If a player cashes out successfully, they receive a payout based on the current multiplier.
help.theUpgradeItemsFeature: The Upgrade Items feature allows users to select multiple items from their inventory and attempt to upgrade them to a higher rarity. The success rate is calculated based on the selected items and the target rarity.
help.welcomeToTheGaming: Welcome to the gaming section! Here's a brief overview of how each game works:
help.yesWePrioritizeThe: Yes, we prioritize the security of your personal information. We use industry-standard encryption and follow best practices to ensure your data is kept safe and secure.
help.yesYouCanUpgrade: Yes, you can upgrade items by selecting them and choosing a target item with a higher rarity. The success rate depends on the rarity of the items.
